> <details>
> <summary>⚠️ Outside diff range comments (1)</summary><blockquote>
> 
> <details>
> <summary>app/src/app/api/utils/extract/route.ts (1)</summary><blockquote>
> 
> `13-41`: _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_
> 
> **SSRF guard is bypassable via DNS resolution, redirects, and incomplete Puppeteer validation.**
> 
> `isSafeUrl` only string-checks the hostname, missing three attack vectors:
> 
> 1. **DNS resolution gap**: A hostname like `internal.local` can resolve to `127.0.0.1` or a private IP, pass the string check, then be fetched.
> 2. **Redirect bypass**: `fetch()` auto-follows redirects by default. A safe URL can `301` to `127.0.0.1`, and the request proceeds unchecked.
> 3. **Puppeteer validation gap**: `page.on('request', ...)` only filters resource types. Redirects during `page.goto()` and subrequests are never validated.
> 
> **The proposed async DNS fix for Puppeteer is architecturally flawed**: The request handler is fire-and-forget. Awaiting async DNS validation doesn't block `req.continue()`, so the request proceeds before validation completes.
> 
> **Correct approach**:
> - **For `fetch()`**: Set `redirect: 'manual'` and validate the `Location` header before following.
> - **For Puppeteer**: Either (a) validate after page load by checking final URL + referrer chain, or (b) configure a request interception policy that synchronously aborts disallowed IPs (requires blocking on IP check, not async DNS). Async DNS in event handlers is unreliable.
> 
> Also applies to: 57–59, 64–136
> 
> </blockquote></details>
> 
> </blockquote></details>
